variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders the place name 'Golan in Bashan', transliterating the qere גּוֹלָ֥ן (gol-an) with its vowel before the final nun. The ketiv גלון would yield a name ordered 'Golon/Gilon', which the ASV does not print. The chapter's only note here (alternative_rendering, 'Or, table-land') concerns the English wording of 'plain' earlier in the verse and does not bear on this unit.
